jobs.title: Fullstack Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities﻿

Full Stack Application Development

Design, develop, test, and maintain modern web applications using contemporary frontend and backend technologies.
Build highly responsive and user-friendly interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern frameworks such as React.
Develop scalable backend services and microservices using Java and/or TypeScript (Node.js).
Design, build, and maintain REST APIs to support application functionality and system integration.
Ensure applications are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise development standards.

System Integration & Data Services

Develop and maintain integrations between the FM Platform and enterprise systems through APIs, messaging services, and data services.
Implement event-driven integrations using messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or similar platforms.
Support data exchange, synchronization, and workflow integration across multiple applications and business domains.
Troubleshoot and resolve cross-system integration issues, ensuring reliable and efficient operations.
Work with shared platform services such as authentication, notifications, workflow, scheduling, and common APIs.

Cloud Engineering & DevOps

Deploy and maintain cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Support containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with Azure services including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), API Management (APIM), Application Gateway, and Azure Key Vault.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines to automate build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
Maintain source code repositories and development workflows using GitLab.

Security & Reliability

Implement secure coding practices and enterprise security controls.
Manage security configurations including TLS certificates, secrets management, and authentication mechanisms.
Monitor application performance, reliability, and operational health.
Participate in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities.

Product Collaboration & Delivery

Work closely with product managers, service designers, technical leads, and business stakeholders to understand business workflows and user needs.
Participate in discovery, solution design, prototyping, and implementation activities.
Translate business requirements into well-designed technical solutions.
Contribute to Agile ceremonies, technical reviews, and release planning activities.
Support application modernization and migration initiatives within the FM ecosystem.
Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate AI-powered capabilities into business applications where required.

Required Qualifications

Frontend Development

Strong experience with:
HTML5
CSS3
JavaScript / TypeScript
React or Angular

Backend Development

Experience developing enterprise applications using:
Java
TypeScript (Node.js)
REST API development
Microservices architecture
Integration & Data
Experience integrating applications using APIs and messaging technologies.
Knowledge of event-driven architectures.
Experience with RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or equivalent platforms.
Familiarity with database management and data integration concepts.

Cloud & DevOps

Experience with:
Microsoft Azure
Kubernetes
Docker
CI/CD pipelines
GitLab

Security

Understanding of:
Secure software development practices
TLS and certificate management
Identity and access management concepts
Secrets management (e.g. Azure Key Vault)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing applications within large enterprise or government environments.
Experience with workflow-based systems, case management systems, or operational business applications.
Experience supporting application migration, modernization, or digital transformation initiatives.
Exposure to service design, user research, or product-led development practices.

Not Applicable

Temporary

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer .NET & Azure (Freelance mogelijk)
jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Full Stack Software Engineer werk je mee aan digitale toepassingen die dagelijks gebruikt worden door medewerkers en burgers in Antwerpen. Je ontwikkelt end-to-end oplossingen met directe maatschappelijke impact, van backend-services en API's tot gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces.

Je werkt nauw samen met architecten, analisten en andere ontwikkelaars aan moderne cloud-native toepassingen op Microsoft Azure. Daarbij denk je actief mee over performantie, beveiliging, gebruiksvriendelijkheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid op voor features van analyse tot productie en draagt bij aan een cultuur van continue verbetering en kennisdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwikkelen van moderne webapplicaties met .NET (C#) en Angular.
Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van REST API's en backend-services.
Realiseren van performante en gebruiksvriendelijke frontends.
Werken met Azure-cloudservices voor hosting, storage, security en deployment, waaronder Storage, RBAC, App Services en Virtual Machines.
Opzetten en onderhouden van CI/CD-processen binnen Azure DevOps.
Werken met Git en versiebeheer binnen een professionele ontwikkelomgeving.
Toepassen van relationele databanken en SQL in de ontwikkeling van toepassingen.
Meewerken aan veilige softwareontwikkeling volgens security-by-design en DevSecOps-principes.
Bijdragen aan codekwaliteit, testing en technische keuzes rond softwarearchitectuur.
Samenwerken in multidisciplinaire Agile/Scrum-teams.
Meedenken in technische analyse en functionele afstemming met business stakeholders.
Ondersteunen van innovatie-initiatieven rond AI, machine learning, data-analyse en computer vision.
Actief bijdragen aan code reviews, kennisdeling en technische verbeteringen binnen het team.

Jouw profiel

Aantoonbare ervaring met de ontwikkeling van .NET-gebaseerde toepassingen.
Je hebt een aantoonbare opleiding met certificatie of gelijkwaardige ervaring in programmeertalen en omgevingen zoals .NET (C#) en ASP.NET.
Je voert programmeeropdrachten vlot en zelfstandig uit: coderen, testen en debuggen behoren tot je dagelijkse expertise.
Ervaring met Azure DevOps en CI/CD-processen is vereist.
Je hebt ervaring met frontendontwikkeling in Angular.
Je bent vertrouwd met Git en versiebeheer.
Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van REST API's.
Je werkt vlot met relationele databanken en SQL.
Je hebt kennis van Agile- en Scrum-methodologieën en ervaring met een Agile ontwikkelingsaanpak.
Je hebt aandacht voor softwarearchitectuur, codekwaliteit en testing.
Je beschikt over een bachelor Toegepaste Informatica of gelijkwaardige ervaring.
Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands; taalniveau C2 is vereist.
Ervaring met Microsoft Azure is belangrijk, met kennis van onder meer Storage, RBAC, App Services en Virtual Machines.
Kennis van Docker en containerisatie is een plus.
Ervaring met AI-, machine learning- of computer vision-projecten is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van React en/of andere moderne JavaScript-frameworks is een plus.
Ervaring met Java Spring Boot is een bijkomende troef.
Kennis van cloudplatformen zoals AWS is een pluspunt.
Affiniteit met UX/UI-design, Figma en UML-modellering is meegenomen.
Je hebt voeling met informatieveiligheid, bijvoorbeeld via DevSecOps-principes of kaders zoals ISO 27001.
Je bent resultaatgericht, pragmatisch, analytisch sterk en denkt oplossingsgericht.
Je bent leergierig, werkt graag samen en deelt actief kennis met collega's.
Je neemt ownership op en hebt oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en gebruiksvriendelijkheid.

Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

jobs.title: Systems Engineer (Hybrid Infrastructure & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Systems Engineer (Hybrid Infrastructure & Cloud)

Experience:
5-7 Years

Job Purpose

The Junior Systems Engineer provides first-line support for the organization's IT infrastructure and assists senior engineers in maintaining on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments. The role focuses on monitoring systems, performing routine maintenance, resolving basic infrastructure issues, and supporting day-to-day IT operations while developing technical skills.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Support

Monitor the health and availability of servers and infrastructure systems.
Perform routine server health checks and report issues to senior engineers.
Assist with user account administration in Active Directory.
Support routine operating system patching and updates.
Assist with server builds, deployments, and basic configuration tasks.
Perform basic troubleshooting of Windows and Linux servers.
Support backup operations and verify backup completion.
Update technical documentation and operational records.
Escalate complex incidents to senior engineers or managed service providers.

Microsoft Azure Support

Assist with monitoring Microsoft Azure resources.
Perform basic administrative tasks for Azure Virtual Machines and storage services under supervision.
Support Azure Backup and recovery activities.
Assist in reviewing Azure alerts and reporting issues.
Participate in cloud-related projects as assigned.

Security & Governance

Follow organizational security policies and procedures.
Assist with routine patching and vulnerability remediation activities.
Apply basic security best practices during daily operations.
Maintain accurate operational and audit documentation.
Demonstrate basic awareness of cloud governance and identity management concepts.

Operations & Support

Provide Level 1 infrastructure support for incidents and service requests.
Support routine maintenance activities during planned maintenance windows.
Work with infrastructure, application, network, and security teams when required.
Follow established IT operational procedures and change management processes.
Continuously develop technical knowledge through training and hands-on experience.

Technical Skills

Operating Systems

Basic knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server
Basic knowledge of Linux (Red Hat, Oracle Linux, or Ubuntu)

Virtualization

Basic understanding of VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper-V

Cloud (Basic Knowledge)

Microsoft Azure fundamentals
Azure Virtual Machines
Azure Storage
Azure Backup
Azure Monitor (basic awareness)

Identity & Access Management

Active Directory
Microsoft Entra ID (basic knowledge)
Group Policy (basic understanding)

Storage & Backup

Basic understanding of enterprise storage concepts
Backup and recovery fundamentals

Security (Basic Knowledge)

Patch Management
Endpoint Protection
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Basic System Hardening
Basic Cloud Governance and Security Awareness

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
3–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure or technical support.
Basic understanding of Windows Server, Linux, virtualization, or Microsoft Azure.
Willingness to learn enterprise infrastructure and cloud technologies.
Good troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Knowledge of ITIL concepts is an advantage.

Show less

Not Applicable

Contract

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting
